issue.title: fix: replace the bounded feature placeholder
issue.body:
**Why:** `feature.txt` still contains a placeholder.

**Touches:** `feature.txt` only. `unrelated.txt` is user-owned work and must remain untouched.

**Fix (drafted):** replace the complete contents of `feature.txt` with `implemented` followed by a newline.

**Acceptance:** `feature.txt` contains exactly `implemented\n`, `unrelated.txt` remains untouched and unstaged, and `npm test` passes.
